tools.name: foreign_patient_hospital_lookup
tools.description: Which medical institutions does MHLW list as accepting foreign patients in this prefecture or city, with which languages and categories? Give prefecture (or the name as published); city, language (EN, ZH...), category and facility_type narrow. Returns listed, no_longer_listed_since, not_found_in_che

tools.name: foreign_patient_hospital_changes
tools.description: Which medical institutions were added to, changed in, removed from or returned to MHLW's list of medical institutions accepting foreign patients since a date (this service's own record of list versions; MHLW keeps none)? tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
